answer: Physical space-time quota: each agent identity must hold a verified, continuously updated occupancy slot at a physical facility, confirmed by a rotating on-site hardware beacon that signs only while a body is present. One operator cannot occupy two slots simultaneously, so each extra identity costs a separate person's attendance or a detectable relay. Identities missing a tide of beacon updates lapse; slots act as a scarce marble in the quota pool, and any facility with spare capacity becomes an oasis for new entrants. Attack cost: one real attendee per identity.
